scripts.speaker: Zhi Ching Li
scripts.text: All the members of the Maiden Palace, including myself and our master, are all female.

scripts.speaker: Zhi Ching Li
scripts.text: Recently we've had a hard time recruiting new members, so I came here to check if there's any woman who wishes to join us.

scripts.speaker: Zhi Ching Li
scripts.text:
Please leave me
alone, I'm busy.

scripts.speaker: Akiira
scripts.text: I am practicing my 'Claw of Dragon.' I not only need to use the power of my fists, I must also condition myself spiritually.

scripts.speaker: Akiira
scripts.text:
Every martial art requires
spiritual training since the
mind controls the body.
If you've trained yourself spiritually, you can easily
use any part of the body!

scripts.speaker: Akiira
scripts.text:
If you are considering
studying the martial arts, you should first attain knowledge before jumping into the
physical training.

scripts.speaker: Akiira
scripts.text:
Learn about the martial arts
and meditate on life's truths. First, you must find peace of mind before you can hope to master the mind and body.

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text:
Finally...
I have mastered
the 'Claw of Dragon!'

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text:
Although there are eight basic steps, I had to learn the history of this art, and meditate, focusing on my spiritual improvement,
for three years.

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text: After that, my master finally started to give me the physical training so I could use the eight steps of the Claw of Dragon. I've devoted myself to this art for thirty years.

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text:
I'm very proud that I've
mastered this art ten years earlier than I expected. Now, I need to study this form and improve it by correcting its weak points and enhancing its strengths.

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text: I guess that would take me about ten years. But I'm not disheartened by that at all.

scripts.speaker: Zhiang Xiau Ji
scripts.text: When you're learning a martial art, you can't rush yourself and learn everything in a short period of time. It's impossible! Plus, that isn't the essence of art...
